affectedStages.currentIncarnation: Gears of War (2006) - Lightmass Bomb train finale
affectedStages.currentGameplayAdaptation: RPG waves condense the train assault and RAAM duel. Kryll shield blocks ordinary damage; frag grenades disperse it, swarm departures expose RAAM, and lit cover protects from the swarm. ATB commands, the shared grenade supply, durations and cover positions adapt the original real-time cover shooter.
affectedStages.currentVisualAnchor: The moving Lightmass Bomb train at night, linked industrial freight cars with low cover and exposed walkways. General RAAM is a huge pale Locust in dark armored plates, carrying his Troika and surrounded by Kryll. No Pendulum Wars Aspho Fields, Skorge, Kantus, Tickers or Brumak in this encounter.

affectedStages.currentVisualAnchor: New Mombasa streets, concrete canals and elevated building catwalks around the Halo 2 Protos-pattern Scarab. No Halo ring, Halo 3 Deutoros exposed rear core, Prometheans, Flood or hostile Guilty Spark.

affectedStages.currentIncarnation: Aliens (1986) - Hadley's Hope atmosphere processor, LV-426
affectedStages.currentGameplayAdaptation: Rescue Newt at the nest marker, then reach the evacuation marker with her living carrier. Queen damage is nonlethal and her defeat cannot win this hive mission. Combat waves, the 2D route, interaction markers and carrier-loss condition adapt the film rescue; Newt is not a damageable combatant. The later Sulaco power-loader finale remains separate and unimplemented.
affectedStages.currentVisualAnchor: The LV-426 atmosphere processor near Hadley's Hope: industrial grated walkways overtaken by dark biomechanical resin, eggs and the Queen's nest. The Queen has a broad crown-like cranial crest, two large arms and two small chest arms, digitigrade legs and a long tail. Warrior Xenomorphs have ridged heads. No Predalien, dog Runner, Ash, Praetorian or Sulaco power-loader bay in this location.

affectedStages.currentGameplayAdaptation: Destroy three healing crystals, weaken the boss and its replenishable reserve of twenty orange spheres, and hit the brain after the head opens. Body hits cannot kill Nihilanth. Platforms, crystal HP, healing intervals and purple projectile timing adapt the source encounter to Smash; green teleport spheres, teleport rooms and summoned reinforcements remain unimplemented.
affectedStages.currentVisualAnchor: Nihilanth's vast organic rock cavern on Xen, with suspended ledges and three healing crystals. A massive levitating creature with a huge head, undersized legs, two main arms and a vestigial third chest arm; orange energy spheres orbit its head, purple projectiles and green teleport spheres. Its crown opens to reveal the brain weak point. Enslaved Vortigaunts wear shackles. No Black Mesa test chamber, Strider, Combine soldier, Advisor, Antlion or Race X.

affectedStages.reason: The source boss and location changed; the historical image depicts the previous incarnation.
affectedStages.currentGameplayAdaptation: Shared mission Stinger targets the radome, then the open cockpit. Body attacks cannot win. Two 360-HP pools, a stationary tactical target, two-to-six-cell range, resupply, turn timing and offscreen Gray Fox assistance adapt MGS (1998). Genome soldiers represent the approach; victory disables REX without killing Liquid or requiring their deaths. The later fistfight is outside this mission. Machine guns, missiles, belly laser and feet use visible danger cells. Three shared chaff grenades disperse radar salvos for two REX attacks; manual cockpit missiles remain dangerous. Footprints, salvo damage and chaff turns are adaptations, not original measurements; five seconds is the original grenade fuse, not jam duration.
affectedStages.currentVisualAnchor: Shadow Moses underground REX hangar, gray bipedal Metal Gear REX with railgun and radome, industrial gantries and Genome Soldiers. No Arsenal Gear, RAY, Gekko or FROG troops from later games.
